purpose: Decide whether the already fitted raw_delta_scale=1.102038 is a locally implementable V1 development candidate using strictly pre-kickoff Football-API four-field xG and outcomes, without treating market agreement or selected bets as ground truth.

disclosed_known_results.legacy_claim_1_848: Previously supplied without a runnable artifact; contradicted by the strict-PIT reconstruction and not reproducible from the committed evidence.
disclosed_known_results.market_conditioning_issue: Selecting the side labelled favorite by the market before averaging fair-minus-market induces a conditional-selection effect; favorite-conditioned means are diagnostic only.

data_contract.point_in_time: For each team use only its latest five team_xg_match rows whose kickoff is strictly earlier than the target kickoff; append the target row only after producing the target input.
data_contract.outcomes: authoritative target fixture home and away goals from the frozen team_xg_match pair

rolling_origin.candidate_prediction: fit raw_delta_scale on rows strictly earlier than each fold, then score the fold once
rolling_origin.current_prediction: score the same fold with raw_delta_scale=1.0

binding_local_implementation_checks.paired_oof_poisson_nll: candidate mean must be lower than current and the 95% fixture bootstrap upper bound for candidate-minus-current must be <= 0
binding_local_implementation_checks.net_margin_calibration: candidate absolute distance of OOF slope from 1 must be lower than current; absolute OOF intercept must be <= 0.10 goals
binding_local_implementation_checks.fold_stability: candidate must lower mean Poisson NLL in at least 7 of 10 rolling-origin folds
binding_local_implementation_checks.totals_invariance: candidate must leave the pre-individual-clamp total unchanged; any individual-lambda clamp effects must be counted and reported

market_diagnostic_only.cohort: the already disclosed strict-PIT 259-fixture market replay
required_outputs: OLS of market-implied home-minus-away delta on raw model delta
forbidden_as_gate: underdog edge selected by the market favorite label
forcing the model to reproduce the market line

settled_candidate_diagnostic_only.allowed: Explain the frozen probability, odds, EV selection and observed settlement per bet.
settled_candidate_diagnostic_only.forbidden: Parameter selection, threshold selection, acceptance, grant or deployment decision.

scope: add raw_delta_scale to LambdaCalibrationParams and apply it once to raw_delta
bump calibration and simulation model versions
align empirical xG standard-error rows to the same latest-five window as the point estimate
